sets.name: Loop Gain
sets.three: When healing ally units, boost their Healing Received by 20% for 4 seconds

sets.name: S.V.M
sets.three: Boost Healing Effect by 10%. Healing Effect is increased to 30% when target's HP is below 45%

sets.name: Delta.V
sets.three: For every 3 Normal Attacks, character's skill recharge is sped up by 1 second

sets.name: Lower Limit
sets.three: When HP drops below 15%, gain Attack Speed +50, ATK +10%, and Damage Reduction +30% for 10 seconds. Triggers once only every battle

sets.name: Paradigm
sets.three: Every 4th Critical Hit deals True Damage of 8% target's current HP, up to twice the current character's Hashrate

sets.name: Data Repair
sets.three: Convert 10% of all damage dealt into HP

sets.name: Encapsulate
sets.three: Obtain supportive ability and take 30% of all damage for the ally unit with the lowest current HP

sets.name: Iteration
sets.three: If not fallen at the end of battle, character is healed by 15% of their Max HP

sets.name: Overflow
sets.three: Gain a Shield equal to 500% Physical DEF at the beginning of battle

sets.name: MLR Matrix
sets.three: Character steals 12% of an enemy unit's ATK, Hashrate and Max HP by defeating them. (When triggered on more than one enemy unit, only the highest stats take effect), and recover HP by the same amount. This effect lasts until the end of battle

sets.name: Exploit
sets.three: Deal 10% additional damage to enemies with an active debuff. For every active debuff, deal 2% more damage to that target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.

sets.name: Stack
sets.three: Every 3 normal attacks will create a stack of [Pursuit Ordnance], max 4 stacks. Every stack deals an additional 10% of Doll's Hashrate in [Derivative] Operand damage

sets.name: Reflection
sets.three: When taking Normal Attack damage from an enemy, reflect 1.2% of self Max HP as true damage to them; when using a Skill, taunt enemies in a 2-tile radius around self for 3 seconds and increase self Backlash by 10% while Taunt is in effect.

sets.name: Resolve
sets.three: When HP is lower than 50%, gain 10% damage reduction. From then onwards, for every 10% of HP lost, gain 5% damage reduction. Every change in HP will refresh the value of this damage reduction

sets.name: Limit Value
sets.three: When dealing damage to an enemy with higher Max HP, additionally deal [Derivative] damage equal to (6% + Enemy Max HP/Self Max HP × 3%), of the same damage type as the original attack, with a maximum of 20%

sets.name: Polybore
sets.three: At the start of the battle, the character's Skill Haste is halved. Every 1% reduction of Skill Haste increases character's damage by 1.2%. Lasts until the end of battle.

sets.name: Hyperpulse
sets.three: At the start of the battle, +10% ATK and Hashrate; gain additional 3% ATK and Hashrate every second after that, stacks up to 10 times. All stacks are cleared 3 seconds after using a skill.

sets.name: Buildup
sets.three: At the start of the battle, +35% Physical and Operand DEF; 5 seconds after using a skill, further increase Physical/Operand DEF by +35%.

sets.name: Acclimate
sets.three: When ally Doll's HP decreases below 30%, grant said Doll a shield of 35% of their Max HP and 5 seconds of Stealth (can only trigger once per battle)

sets.name: Delivery
sets.three: After using a skill, all Dolls' ATK and Hashrate are increased by +20% for 7 seconds. Does not stack.

sets.name: Flush
sets.three: When the carrier applies a debuff, said unit takes 16% more damage. Lasts for 6 seconds and cannot stack.
